nodes.label: Singleton DB Connection Pattern
nodes.rationale: Thread-safe singleton with _lock and _connection global ensures a single shared SQLite connection for the whole app lifetime, enabling WAL mode and foreign keys once at startup.

nodes.label: Singleton AppState Pattern
nodes.rationale: AppState uses __new__ singleton so the current shift ID and worker name are globally accessible without passing state through every UI constructor.

nodes.label: Session Type System (neograniceno/prepaid/pass1/pass2/minecraft)
nodes.rationale: Five billing modes differentiate pricing: unlimited (hourly post-pay), prepaid (time from upfront payment), pass1 (bonus hours), pass2 (evening flat-rate), minecraft (fixed hourly rate). tip string discriminates behaviour across pazar, UI display, and session timing.
